Congrads Danny, that's great news.

My only suggest is using warmer IPAs if you are looking to duplicate the color. At least that is what worked for me on the coin series. Also 2.5% AmDi gave more realistic colors while 1% was a bit more red/gold. Other then that best of luck.

Tony
